label: Lean coffee
description: An agenda-less meeting: everyone proposes topics, the team votes, and each topic is discussed in a short timebox.

types.label: Topic
types.description: Something you want to talk about. One topic per entry; the team votes on the order.

types.label: Insight
types.description: Something the team learned or agreed while discussing a topic.

types.label: Concern
types.description: Something left unresolved, or a worry a topic raised.

types.label: Takeaway
types.description: Something to do as a result of a discussion.
types.prompt:
Topic: 
What we will do: 
Who:

questions: Which topics did we run out of time for, and do they need their own session?
aiGuidance: Topics are the agenda, not feedback: list them (most-mentioned first) but do not judge them. Summarise insights and concerns per topic where possible. Each takeaway should name its topic.
